title: Cache growth preserves the prefix
purpose: A single layer stores one K and V row for each processed token; each append extends the valid prefix.
contract: payload(T) = 2 × L × T × Hkv × Dₕ × 4 bytes
caption: A single layer stores one K and V row for each processed token; each append extends the valid prefix. L = 1, Hkv = 1, Dₕ = 2, F32. payload(T) = 2 × L × T × Hkv × Dₕ × 4 bytes. T = 1,2,3,4 → 16,32,48,64 bytes.
